summary: One-frame event of experience gained (dialogue XP rewards and kills: born in dialog/spell steps). Holds the eoc::exp::ObjectGainedXPEvent list built by esv::exp::ExperienceSystem::UpdateExperience.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: UpdateExperience (EoCServer.dll+0x701E50) appends eoc::exp::ObjectGainedXPEvent (name from its IndexedStorage assert, stride 0x10): +0 = the entity of the EntityView<ExperienceComponent, AvailableLevelComponent> (view+0x28).

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: +8 = the int XP argument of UpdateExperience (added to ExperienceComponent's current/next/total experience).

fields.name: field_C
fields.evidence: +0xC = ExperienceComponent byte +0xC (SE ExperienceComponent.field_28), set to 1 when the gain reached the level cap branch, 0 otherwise.
